t: This is Neptune and Triton, a marble sculpture just over a hundred and eighty centimetres tall, now in the Victoria and Albert Museum. Gian Lorenzo Bernini made it around 1622 to 1623, early in his career. He's remembered as the leading sculptor of his age, and the man credited with creating the Baroque style of sculpture. It was commissioned by Cardinal Alessandro Peretti di Montalto, who had been made a cardinal at just fourteen, by his great-uncle, who had been elected Pope Sixtus the Fifth.
